Loaded automatically when a session reads anything under this folder. It says what each
part of the folder is for and how work here runs. Business facts are NOT here - they
live in `CONTEXT.md`. Open decisions and entry status live in `PROJECT-PLAN.md`.

## Read first, by task

| Task | Read |
|---|---|
| Anything about the business (prices, contacts, access, NAP) | `CONTEXT.md` |
| Any live-site edit | `../../portal/SQUARESPACE-REFERENCE.md`, then `PROJECT-PLAN.md` "Decisions already taken" |
| Design judgement on the Squarespace site | `../../playbooks/squarespace-polish.md` (its Scope section: ERF is being replaced by a custom build, so polish spend is throwaway) |
| The custom rebuild | `rebuild/PROJECT-PLAN.md` |
| SEO / AEO on-page work | `seo-onpage/PROJECT-PLAN.md` |

## The live site is the source of truth

The site is Squarespace 7.1 Basic, edited by browser automation against the live admin.
There is no local build and no PR for a live edit. Every `*-payload.html`, `*-LIVE*.html`
and `.less` file in this folder is a **snapshot**, not the current state. Before editing,
pull the live block or the compiled `custom.css` and work from that.

## How a live change runs

Each change gets its own folder, `<topic>-<YYYY-MM-DD>/`, with numbered scripts in run
order. Examples: `contact-copy-2026-09-21/` and `meta-descriptions-2026-09-20/`.

1. **Probe**: `01-*.mjs` reads the live page or editor state. Save what you pulled
   (`live-*.html`, `custom-css-before.less`) as the restore point.
2. **Payload**: the new HTML or CSS, saved in the folder.
3. **Apply**: the script that writes it. Rich text uses TipTap `setContent`, never
   `innerHTML` or paste. Check the block content before clicking SAVE.
4. **Verify from outside**: an anonymous fetch (`*verify-anon.mjs` or plain `curl`), then
   screenshots at 1440 and 390. The admin session lies about what is public.
5. **Log**: `node ~/.claude/scripts/change-log.js` with project `engineroomfitness`,
   and update the entry's row in `PROJECT-PLAN.md`.

A folder with a payload and no anonymous verify has not shipped. Treat it as unfinished.

## Folder map

| Folder | Holds |
|---|---|
| `squarespace/` | Custom CSS backups and restore points (`css-restore/`), per-section `.less` |
| `hero-recovery-2026-09-20/` | Most recent custom CSS snapshots (`custom-css-live-2026-09-21.less`) |
| `home-restructure/`, `our-classes-*`, `contact-copy-*`, `about-us-*`, `footer-rebuild/`, `coaches-squarespace/`, `gym-news-cards/`, `open-day-*`, `pricing-visibility/`, `reviews/` | One folder per page or section change: scripts, payloads, live snapshots |
| `meta-descriptions-2026-09-20/`, `seo-onpage/`, `gsc-reindex/`, `psi/` | SEO, indexing and speed work |
| `gbp-video-2026-09-21/` | Google Business Profile automation |
| `hero-triptych/`, `home1-hero-video/` | Hero video builds (Python compositing) and the swap onto the live page |
| `assets/`, `logo*/`, `mockups/`, `before-rebuild/` | Images: before/after sets, headshots, logo work, mockups |
| `rebuild/` | Custom-build IA, content inventory, briefs |
| `reports/` | Client-facing reports. `sent/` holds what actually went to Eoin |
| `inbox/` | Material received from the client, as received |
| `phone-project/` | Instructions and knowledge for the claude.ai Project used for quick ERF SEO/AEO jobs from the phone |
| `drive-media-assessment/`, `checklist-2026-08-25/`, `style-parity-2026-08-25/` | Finished one-off assessments, kept for evidence |

Loose files at the root are dated briefs, drafts to Eoin, audits and design reviews.
Use the date in the filename to find the latest; the newest `DESIGN-REVIEW-*` and
`SITE-SCAN-*` are the current audit baseline.

## Where new work goes

- A new live change: a new `<topic>-<date>/` folder, laid out as above. Do not add
  scripts to an older change folder.
- A new client-facing report: `reports/`, then move it to `reports/sent/` once sent.

- A new fact about the business: `CONTEXT.md`, in the same commit as the decision.

Here is the plan. I wrote it from the ERF workspace map and `docs/portal/SQUARESPACE-REFERENCE.md`, and nothing was run.

**Before you start (challenge):** ERF is being handed over to non-technical owners and replaced by a custom build. Your rulings say ERF work is limited to defects and changes the client asked for, so this change should trace back to a request from Eoin. You also ruled that no new display copy goes out without you, so the new hero line has to be one you picked from options I put to you.

## Steps

| # | Step | How I verify it |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | **Gate.** Confirm Eoin asked for the change, and get your pick of the new line from 2-3 options. Run the paraphrase test and the slot test on each option. | A `client-log.js` entry for Eoin's request, and your recorded pick. |
| 1 | **Folder.** Create `docs/clients/engineroomfitness/hero-copy-2026-10-13/` with numbered scripts. | The folder exists. Nothing goes into older change folders. |
| 2 | **Anonymous probe.** `curl` the live page and save it as `live-before.html`. Note the exact hero text and its tag (h1 or h2). | HTTP 200, and the hero string appears in the raw HTML exactly once. Because the curl sends no cookies, this is what visitors actually see. |
| 3 | **Admin session check.** Use raw CDP to the Brave on 9222 and open the page editor. | The frame URL is the admin, not `login.squarespace.com`. That redirect means the session expired, and only you can sign back in. |
| 4 | **Find the block and save a restore point.** Get the hero's `.tiptap.ProseMirror` element and save `element.editor.getHTML()` as `block-before.html`. Keep the pointer away from the top of the iframe, because hovering there opens "Editing Site Header" and can throw away unsaved edits. | The editor's text matches the hero string from step 2 exactly. That confirms I have the right block. |
| 5 | **Payload.** Write `payload.html`: the same tag with Squarespace's own `class`, `style` and `data-rte-preserve-empty` attributes, and only the text changed. Grep the page's SEO title and meta description, and any other page that repeats the hero claim. | A diff of `block-before.html` against `payload.html` shows a change to the text node only. Any other surface that now contradicts the new line is listed. |
| 6 | **Apply.** Run `element.editor.commands.setContent(payload, true)`. Never use `innerHTML`, a paste, or Ctrl+A then Backspace: the paste stacks the new copy on top of the old, and Ctrl+A then Backspace deletes a one-line block. | See step 7. |
| 7 | **Check before SAVE.** Confirm all four: the editor text equals the new line, the old line's wording is gone, the page has the same number of blocks as before, and the page Save button is now enabled. | If any check fails, I don't save. I leave the page and accept the `beforeunload` dialog, and the last saved state comes back unchanged. |
| 8 | **Save.** Click `[data-test="frameToolbarSave"]`, then reload the editor. | After the reload, the editor shows the new HTML. |
| 9 | **Verify from outside.** Repeat the anonymous `curl`. Then take screenshots at 1440 and 390 in a fresh browser context with no cookies, and read them myself. | HTTP 200, the new line appears once, and the old line is gone. In the screenshots the hero wraps cleanly and doesn't overflow on mobile. The admin view doesn't count as proof. |
| 10 | **Log and commit.** Run `change-log.js --project engineroomfitness`, update the entry's row in ERF's `PROJECT-PLAN.md`, and commit the folder (probe, payload, scripts). | Both the log entry and the commit exist. Under the ERF map's rules, a folder with no anonymous verify counts as unshipped. |

**Rollback:** run `setContent(block-before.html, true)`, then repeat steps 7-9.
